title: PlaneMem reviewed bounded audit view export
description: Source-only selection, normalized bounded audit record/document and release-confirmed envelope. Static shapes do not compute canonical UTF8 byte lengths/SHA256, authorize export or establish client delivery.
$comment: Runtime also checks exact selected scope/audit/trace, distinct release ID, source ordering, valid dates and UTF16 scope bounds. Record parsers accept some extensions then reconstruct known fields; this schema describes normalized output. No validators, generators or runtime evidence.

scopeText.$comment: Actual <=256 UTF16 units, no controls/DEL/lone surrogates. Whitespace-only is permitted; not independently ULID. Scalar-count maxLength cannot fully express UTF16 rule.

jsonValue.description: Finite JSON values; integer values must be safe. Export canonicalization permits only plain/null-prototype objects,<=10000 nodes and depth<=64 over the whole normalized document. Details can be any such JSON value, including scalar/null, not only an object.

source.description: Normalized original record source. Parser strips extensions; no type/URI allowlist, uniqueness or current-source proof. Source extension bytes count in raw candidate budgets before stripping.

occurred_at.$comment: Actual valid exact UTC calendar roundtrip for milliseconds, preserving microseconds. Parser accepts3 or6 fractional digits and normalizes3 to6. Not arbitrary Date.parse text.

record.description: Complete normalized bounded view, not raw stored audit record. Nullable session_id otherwise only nonempty text, not ULID-enforced. Metadata budget covers audit/actor/client/session/action/resource/result/classification/trace/normalized time. PostgreSQL original JSONB text sizes remain as byte counts, not required to equal normalized JS JSON byte lengths. Available fields also independently satisfy JS serialization limits; omitted fields retain original size and null/[] placeholders. Historical record trace differs from request trace; no current-source inspection or restoration of omitted content.

request.description: Only original reviewed scope/ID/canonical-document SHA256, no supplied document/actor/capability/key/version. Header-authorized scope must equal each selected scope field. HTTP raw decoded body<=4096 bytes after auth; handler also checks JSON.stringify(input)<=4096. Shared request parser alone does not enforce bytes.

document.description: Canonicalization reconstructs record/scope, recursively sorts object keys using JS sort then JSON.stringify (array order preserved). UTF8 canonical text<=96KiB; finite safe-integer JSON. This project convention is not a claimed standard JCS implementation. Digest covers bounded normalized view only, not hidden original data, whole envelope, signature or client file.

result.description: document scope/record ID match original selection; release ID differs from target. document_bytes equals canonical UTF8 document length, SHA256 equals original selection AND independently computed digest. Shared envelope parser checks declaration/length but does not itself hash; Gateway and SDK hash separately. Confirmed durable release authorizes this prepared view, not client receipt/file save.

trace_id.description: Exact current request trace; shared export parser adds equality, not a separate text-length validator.

envelope.description: Source order exactly target audit then release audit, IDs different. No ETag/revision/cursor/current identity/permissions. Complete normalized JSON<=128KiB; shared parser rejects unknown outer/data/document/scope/source fields and reconstructs record. Success is never a cached original result.

failureState.description: Details of handler-created fail errors, not universal error details. Known release ID differs from target. Unconfirmed means no acknowledgment available, not proof of absent write; timeout can race an in-flight sink. SDK returns this normalized state once target known, preserves only trusted same-trace known release and sets retryable=false.
